name: How long will my home be disrupted during an interior renovation?
description: Disruption varies; a single-room renovation might take 4-8 weeks, while a whole-home project could involve several months of widespread impact.

mainEntity.name: How long will my home be disrupted during an interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of disruption depends on the scope of work. A single-room renovation, like a bathroom, might disrupt that area for 4-8 weeks. A whole-home renovation will likely mean more widespread disruption, possibly requiring you to relocate temporarily for several months. We work to minimize inconvenience by maintaining a clean worksite and providing clear communication about schedules and access.
